content.text: {"headline":"Approve R1: card-decline outage message, 20% chat deflection, delayed payments breaks and 40 overtime offers. Predicted 83.8% service level for 12:00-14:00 at ₹15,528.","why":"Payments demand has surged because of P1 incident INC-20261009-3059, where the card gateway is declining debit cards. Payments calls reached 212 against 108.7 forecast, and card_declined calls account for most of the excess. With no action, service level for 12:00-14:00 is predicted at 39.4% with 17.4% abandons. R1 meets the 80% target with no policy violations. Payments is predicted at 81.2% and general at 88.5%, abandons fall to 4.8%, and the rest-of-day figure is 89.0%. The outage message covers card declines only, so fraud reports still reach an agent, in line with CX-04.","trade_offs":["Cheaper options miss the target. P1 costs ₹0 and actually lowers service level to 34.9%. P2 reaches only 62.4% for ₹1,128.","P3 (76.4%, ₹8,100) and P4 (80.8%, ₹11,928) cost less than R1 but break policy CX-04, because their IVR message deflects fraud reports.","R2 costs the same ₹15,528 but predicts lower service levels: 80.8% overall and 76.6% for payments, which is below target. Its abandon rate is slightly better, at 4.2% against R1's 4.8%.","There is no risk to the general queue. It improves from 65.5% to 88.5%."],"watch":"Watch overtime uptake. R1 depends on enough of the 40 payments agents accepting overtime for 12:30-14:30. Also track progress on the incident. If the gateway fix slips past 14:00, the disruption window extends beyond what this plan covers."}
